evals.prompt: Which flag keeps a new worker profile from inheriting the bundled skills, and where is it verified?
evals.expected_output: --no-skills on hermes profile create, checked against hermes profile create --help.

evals.prompt: How do I pin just one kanban card to another model without editing the profile?
evals.expected_output: Per-task model override: --model/--provider at card creation or hermes kanban set-model.
